title: Pretty
text: Pretty. Realize that you are just getting a thin plain piece of paper probably of the same quality that you could have printed it. But it was fine. The print itself is very pretty and nice. I love the saying. I have this in a larger canvas. As long as you know what you are getting, it is fine. Wish the pictures were less misleading.
